findings.claim: Users may be told there is a fresh NDEF message when the observed tag content is multiple records or malformed/non-OpenSpool, causing confusion and possible unnecessary retries.

dispositions.reason: NDEF messages can contain multiple records and non-MIME records. Coordinator obtains records from one active getNdefMessage call; wording does not claim single record or matching OpenSpool content.

evidence.source: WriteStateMachine.kt: val record=tag.records.singleOrNull(); val matches=record!=null && record.tnf==2 && record.mime==OpenSpoolCodec.MIME && ...; else detail=if(tag.records.isEmpty()) "No NDEF message returned..." else "Fresh NDEF message does not match; no automatic rewrite". Given multiple records, singleOrNull() is null and the 'Fresh NDEF message' phrase is still used.

immutable.suggested_validation: Create tests where tag.records has two records and where it has one record with tnf=1; assert the detail contains a neutral mismatch phrase and does not contain 'Fresh NDEF message'.
immutable.summary: The nonempty mismatch detail 'Fresh NDEF message does not match; no automatic rewrite' is inaccurate when the tag contains more than one record or when the single record does not have the OpenSpool MIME/TNF.
